verdict.rationale: jo is itself a personal AI agent, and its docs show many delegated tasks. Users can give it a job and a schedule, have it file bugs and create or comment on Linear issues, and ask it to build, publish and update websites. It can also generate decks and work overnight on its own machine across macOS, Telegram, WhatsApp and email. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks actually complete as claimed.
